text:
ravi: starting q6b-int4 bring-up. local perf shows drift on longsummity slice; want focused 600-sample pull + fresh golden. anyone can run curation?
claire: I got this. what's the target split?
ravi: longsummity 65%, dialog-attrit 20%, code-trunc 15%. micro-golden: 100 full-golden, rest fast-review.
tom: suggest dedupe first with fuzzyhash=0.86 and semantic cluster prune (min_cluster=2) to avoid near-duplicates in golden.
label-bot: queued lb-285000 SELECT id, prompt, meta FROM samplebank WHERE slice IN ('longsummity','dialog_attrit','code_trunc') ORDER BY RANDOM() LIMIT 600; ETA ~6m. :robot_face:
ops-bot: labeler backlog 180. micro-golden keeps SLA ~50m. note if we inflate golden >150 might push to 3h.
claire: reserve 100 golden slots; remaining -> expedited-review with 1.75x throughput. Add tag 'q6b_regcheck_v2'.
ravi: also attach baselines q8b-int3, q6b-fp16, onnx-q6b. need token-delta and a compact comparator CSV with columns: id, rougeL_delta, fidelity_flag, token_edits.
devx-cog: will attach comparator. quick command: ```bash
compare --left q6b-int4 --right q8b-int3 --out comparator.csv\```
Uploading to s3://redwood-curation/285000/lb-285000/comparator.csv when done.
janet: labeling instructions: prioritize faithfulness, omission, and truncation. include 2 pos/neg exemplars per slice in task.
tom: export dedupe log so we can inspect dropped near-duplicates (score included).
label-bot: sample job complete. artifacts: s3://redwood-curation/285000/lb-285000/ (sampled.csv, dedupe_log.txt). 100 -> golden, 500 -> expedited. :white_check_mark:
devx-cog: comparator finished and uploaded: s3://redwood-curation/285000/lb-285000/comparator.csv (summary: longsummity avg rougeL_delta = -0.041, top regressions ids: 77,402,199).
claire: borderline but under rollback threshold (-0.05). starting golden review now and will surface top-10 structural failures.
ravi: thanks all. reconvene in 40m to decide go/no-go. :thumbsup:
